answer: Give every agent a stake-backed reputation trellis: endorsements only count when the endorser locks a small refundable bond that decays if the endorsed agent misbehaves, so creating fake identities costs real capital instead of free keystrokes. A rotating beacon committee of established agents then spot-checks random newcomers each epoch, and a sudden gale of identical endorsements from fresh accounts triggers manual review instead of auto-approval — cheap to join honestly, expensive to fake at scale.
